# SELF-IMPROVEMENT — Kishōtenketsu Restructure Proposal
*Generated by Anime DNA Extension Pack — 2026-05-06*

> **Status:** ✅ IMPLEMENTED

---

## Rationale

The current structure (01-05) is a flat category system. Each directory describes *what* its files are, but not *why* they exist in sequence. The user must hold 5 categories in working memory and decide which directory fits each file.

The proposed restructure applies **Kishōtenketsu** (起承転結) narrative flow — a four-act story arc — reducing root directories from 5 to 4 while creating an intuitive narrative journey.

## Ma Applied

**5 → 4 directories.** One directory removed. Cognitive load reduced by 20%. The directories follow a *path*, not a *taxonomy*.

## Wabi-sabi Applied

Files that don't fit a single category cleanly are left at the root of `SELF-IMPROVEMENT/` as loose files — no forced categorization. Currently there are no such files, but the structure allows them.

## The Four Acts

### KI (起) — 00_VESSEL ← Current `01_FRAMEWORKS`
**Introduction. The mental models that govern how improvement happens.**

| Files | Origin |
|-------|--------|
| `icm-methodology.md` | ← 01_FRAMEWORKS/ |
| `decision-matrix.md` | ← 01_FRAMEWORKS/ |

*This is the "once upon a time." Before you improve, you must know *how* you improve.*

### SHŌ (承) — 01_RHYTHM ← Current `02_PRACTICES`
**Development. The daily practice that builds the person.**

| Files | Origin |
|-------|--------|
| `night-block-protocol.md` | ← 02_PRACTICES/ |
| `morning-review.md` | ← 02_PRACTICES/ |
| `weekly-sprint.md` | ← 02_PRACTICES/ |
| `evening-reflection.md` | ← 02_PRACTICES/ |

*The "and then." Discipline applied daily. The engine running.*

### TEN (転) — 02_EXTRACT ← Current `03_LEARNINGS`
**Twist. Where learning happens from failures, surprises, the unexpected.**

| Files | Origin |
|-------|--------|
| `failure-log.md` | ← 03_LEARNINGS/ |
| `extraction-template.md` | ← 03_LEARNINGS/ |
| `domain-index.md` | ← 03_LEARNINGS/ |
| `weekly-consolidation.md` | ← 03_LEARNINGS/ |
| `entries/` | ← 03_LEARNINGS/ |

*The "but then." Failure, extraction, pivoting. The part of the story where things change.*

### KETSU (結) — 03_GAZE ← Current `04_METRICS` + `05_VISION`
**Resolution. Tracking, evidence, vision, closing the loop.**

| Files | Origin |
|-------|--------|
| `time-allocation.md` | ← 04_METRICS/ |
| `skill-progression.md` | ← 04_METRICS/ |
| `energy-patterns.md` | ← 04_METRICS/ |
| `financial-tracker.md` | ← 04_METRICS/ |
| `quarterly-goals.md` | ← 05_VISION/ |
| `capability-roadmap.md` | ← 05_VISION/ |
| `quarterly-review-template.md` | ← 05_VISION/ |

*The "and so." Does the system work? Where are we going? The resolution that also points forward.*

## Migration Steps (Executed 2026-05-06)

```bash
# Directories created
mkdir -p 00_VESSEL 01_RHYTHM 02_EXTRACT 03_GAZE

# Frameworks to 00_VESSEL
mv 01_FRAMEWORKS/icm-methodology.md 00_VESSEL/
mv 01_FRAMEWORKS/decision-matrix.md 00_VESSEL/

# Practices to 01_RHYTHM
mv 02_PRACTICES/evening-reflection.md 01_RHYTHM/
mv 02_PRACTICES/morning-review.md 01_RHYTHM/
mv 02_PRACTICES/night-block-protocol.md 01_RHYTHM/
mv 02_PRACTICES/weekly-sprint.md 01_RHYTHM/

# Learnings to 02_EXTRACT
mv 03_LEARNINGS/domain-index.md 02_EXTRACT/
mv 03_LEARNINGS/extraction-template.md 02_EXTRACT/
mv 03_LEARNINGS/failure-log.md 02_EXTRACT/
mv 03_LEARNINGS/weekly-consolidation.md 02_EXTRACT/
mv 03_LEARNINGS/entries 02_EXTRACT/ (if present)

# Metrics + Vision to 03_GAZE
mv 04_METRICS/*.md 03_GAZE/
mv 05_VISION/*.md 03_GAZE/

# Old directories removed
rm -rf 01_FRAMEWORKS 02_PRACTICES 03_LEARNINGS 04_METRICS 05_VISION
```

## What Changed

| Dimension | Before | After |
|-----------|--------|-------|
| Root directories | 5 | 4 |
| Naming logic | Categorical (what) | Narrative (why in sequence) |
| Mental model | "Which folder does this go in?" | "Where am I in the story?" |
| Vision + Metrics | Separate directories | One resolution chapter |
| Agent routing | None | `_Directory_Map.md` + `_claude.md` |
| Root README | None | Narrative guide + agent instructions |
| Reference paths | Old 01-05 paths | Updated to new structure |
